rule: first-party code starts a worker from a path built at run time, in a development build, which ships what the bundler writes unminified. The bundler inlines a constant in both modes, which closure/missing then catches, so the path comes from the page.

edits.append:
const ntnFixtureWorker = location.hash.slice(1) || 'js/workers/ntn-fixture.js';
window.ntnFixtureStarted = new Worker(ntnFixtureWorker);
